summary: Tested both backend (12 pytest cases) and frontend (Playwright E2E) for CP Stress Tester. All backend verdicts (WA/AC/CE/TLE/RTE/MLE, Python + C++ + Java), preview (simple+advanced), languages endpoint, and generator error handling pass. Frontend loads correctly with 3-column layout; default C++ WA flow finds counterexample, test-row-1 expands showing Input/Expected/Your Output diff, summary-counts renders (WA1), simple and advanced generator previews produce output, config inputs accept values, tab switching works.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py execute() polls VmRSS every 3ms which is aggressive under load; could add small back-off. MLE detection currently works.
run_stress endpoint is declared without async but uses subprocess+threads; acceptable because FastAPI runs sync def in threadpool. Fine.
No auth/rate-limit on /api/run – arbitrary code execution is inherent to the product but consider a global concurrency semaphore to avoid resource exhaustion.
'results-panel' data-testid is on a container that reports non-visible via is_visible() when empty, but visually the panel is present. Not a bug – informational.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_stress_api.py covers root, languages, preview (simple/adv/error), and /api/run for CPP-WA, PY-AC, JAVA-AC, CE, TLE, RTE, MLE. Frontend Playwright verified default C++ WA flow, preview both modes, tab switching, config inputs, expand test row diff, summary counts.
